title: the fourth man in the fire

verses.text: “Look!” he exclaimed. “I see four men, unbound and unharmed, walking around in the fire—and the fourth looks like a son of the gods! ”

onScreenText: “Look!” he exclaimed. “I see four men, unbound and unharmed, walking around in the fire—and the fourth looks like a son of the gods! ”
scenes: the mouth of an enormous ancient brick furnace at night, white hot fire roaring inside, sparks streaming up into a black sky, seen from a distance, no people
four figures in complete silhouette walking unhurried through the middle of a wall of white and orange flame, unbound and unharmed, backlit so no faces are visible, embers drifting
the fire burned down to glowing embers and settling ash, quiet and still, no people
